title: const, constexpr and #define
expectedStdout:
weekly fee: 21
years: 3, compound factor: 1.15763
bad macro: 5 vs good: 9
tryThis: Try `days = 8;`: assigning to a `const` is a compile error.
Make `growth` `constexpr` and read the year count from stdin: it can't be computed at compile time anymore, so `constexpr` fails, while `const` would be fine.
